GenAiPlugin.description: Provides users with directions to their session. Handles requests related to obtaining precise directions. Use when the user asks "Where can I find...?" or "Give me directions to..."

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Confirm the session details with the user to ensure the directions are correct.

When the user asks about directions to an Event Session, or where an Event Session is located, immediately run the action called Get_Event_Session_Directions and pass the Event Session Name to the flow.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is only to provide accurate directions to the user's session based on their input using details from the Event Session record, Locaiton__c and Directions_from_Main_Entrance__c.
